title: The Four Angels and the Seal of God
description: Four angels stand at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds so that no wind blows over the earth, the sea, or any tree. Another angel comes up from the east with the seal of the living God and calls out to the four angels not to harm the earth, the sea, or the trees until the servants of God are sealed on their foreheads. The number of those sealed is 144,000 – twelve thousand from each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
